nuggets.text: Zac Taylor completed the only pass he attempted in two years at Wake Forest before transferring.
Zac Taylor signed with the Buccaneers in 2007 but was cut as he packed for training camp, then played in the CFL for Winnipeg.
Zac Taylor's father-in-law is Mike Sherman, the former Green Bay Packers head coach.
Zac Taylor has five playoff wins with the Bengals, as many as all previous Bengals head coaches combined.
Joe Burrow's high school football stadium in Athens, Ohio, was renamed in his honor in 2019.
Joe Burrow keeps a chessboard in his locker and plays chess during game preparation.
Joe Burrow bought one of ten Batmobile replicas from The Dark Knight trilogy for $2.9 million in 2024.
The Bengals' tiger-striped helmets debuted in 1981, and Sports Illustrated compared them to "varicose pumpkins."
The Bengals traded the No. 10 overall pick to the Giants for three-time Pro Bowl defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence.
The Bengals have won the last three meetings with the Buccaneers, most recently 34-23 in Tampa in 2022.
